name: repo-platform
description: Tooling manifest for repo-platform (biome, husky, the bun scripts' yaml parser and zod schemas); the actions carry their own dependencies, which the root postinstall installs so one root bun install covers every action package.

scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run lint:actions && bun run lint:sh && bun run lint:secrets && bun run typecheck && bun run typography && bun run wrap:check && bun run lint:yaml && bun run validate && bun run validate:registry && bun run validate:skills && bun run ssot:check && bun run guards:binding && bun run generate:check && bun run dogfood:check && bun run gitignore:topology && bun run compose:check && bun run renders:check && bun run test
scripts.lint:actions: if command -v actionlint >/dev/null; then actionlint; else echo 'actionlint not installed locally; CI runs it (brew install actionlint)'; fi
scripts.lint:secrets: if command -v gitleaks >/dev/null; then gitleaks git --no-banner --redact && gitleaks git --no-banner --redact --pre-commit --staged; else echo 'gitleaks not installed locally; CI runs it (brew install gitleaks)'; fi
scripts.lint:sh: if command -v shellcheck >/dev/null; then find .github/scripts -name "*.sh" -print0 | xargs -0 shellcheck -x; else echo 'shellcheck not installed locally; CI runs it (brew install shellcheck)'; fi
scripts.typecheck: bun x tsc -p . && (cd actions/check-typography && bun x tsc -p .) && (cd actions/fuzz-issue && bun x tsc -p .) && (cd actions/release-health && bun x tsc -p .) && (cd actions/validate-commit-names && bun x tsc -p .) && (cd actions/validate-skills && bun x tsc -p .) && (cd actions/validate-template && bun x tsc -p .) && (cd actions/validate-template-report && bun x tsc -p .)
scripts.regen: bun run generate && bun run dogfood && bun run renders
scripts.postinstall: for pkg in actions/*/package.json; do bun install --frozen-lockfile --silent --cwd "${pkg%/package.json}" || exit 1; done
